blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than policies and diplomatic agreements, the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits also gave the public a glimpse of the lighter side of world leaders. With everyone’s eyes on Manila from Nov. 15 to 17, some leaders made headlines not just for their participation in high-level discussions but also for their social media posts, dance moves, and even their appearance. ‘Dito ang Tingin,’ says SG PM Lawrence Wong It began with Singaporean Prime Minister Lawrence Wong, whose arrival video quickly caught the attention of Filipino netizens.
